texts: Mortality for repair of pulmonary artery sling is zero: C, as the book reports.

The left pulmonary artery is divided, brought in front of the trachea and reimplanted into the main pulmonary artery on cardiopulmonary bypass, and in experienced hands this is done without operative deaths.
The risk rises when complete tracheal rings also need repair, which is why other series report a small mortality.
Video-assisted division suits a simple ring closed by a ligamentum, not a double aortic arch.
In the picture, every slung baby goes home and no coffin stands anywhere.
Memory hook: the sling's score is zero.
